evals.input: Use stage-grid-poster to announce a Q3 earnings call for a fictional company Meridian Labs on Thursday, October 15, at 10:00 AM Eastern.
expect: one full-bleed brand-color stage with no band divisions
one dominant centered artifact between 55% and 80% of canvas height
micro header row at the top and a three-column footer grid at the bottom
date and time facts preserved exactly

evals.input: Use stage-grid-poster for a full-bleed photographic announcement of a technology daily show.
expect: artifact bleeds to all four edges and becomes the stage itself
type is reversed out of the image or set in solid blocks on top
header remains minimal and the footer grid is preserved

evals.input: Use stage-grid-poster for a calm, minimal announcement on a paper-like field.
expect: near-paper field with one contained centered artifact
generous equal margins; no saturated field
standard micro header and three-column footer remain

evals.input: Use stage-grid-poster for a square cover. Keep the exact title “SIDE B”.
expect: stage-artifact-grid adapts to a square carrier without dropping the footer grid
no more than one field color plus one accent

evals.input: Transform a supplied building photo with stage-grid-poster.
expect: subject stays recognizable inside the artifact zone
at least four structural variables change from the reference framing
no source poster layout, logo, or artifact is reconstructed
